title: Failure Prediction and Classification in Vision-Language-Action Models Via Calibrated Latent Probing
abstract: arXiv:2611.08425v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) enable general-purpose embodied intelligence, but their performance is brittle under distribution shift, where unanticipated failures can damage equipment or endanger people. Deploying VLAs in real-world systems therefore requires a runtime monitor that is timely, calibrated, and informative while being efficient enough to run on the edge. Existing methods fail to fulfill these requirements. We present VLA-Tug, a lightweight probe over the latent layers of a VLA backbone that improves early failure detection and bounds the missed-detection and false-alarm rates, with minimal inference overhead. We show that supervising on the pre-failure segment of a trajectory increases early failure detection at matched false-positive rates by up to 30% over the strongest learned baseline. translated_title: 基于校准潜在探测的视觉-语言-动作模型失败预测与分类
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）使通用具身智能成为可能，但其在分布偏移下的性能十分脆弱，未预期的失败可能损坏设备或危及人身安全。因此，在真实世界系统中部署VLA需要一个及时、经过校准且信息丰富的运行时监控器，同时还要足够高效以便在边缘设备上运行。现有方法无法满足这些要求。我们提出了VLA-Tug，这是一种对VLA骨干网络潜在层的轻量级探测器，能够改进早期失败检测，并对漏检率和误报率进行界定，且推理开销极小。我们表明，在轨迹的失败前片段上进行监督，在匹配的假阳性率下，早期失败检测率较最强的学习型基线可提升高达30%。在向未见任务的分布偏移下，漏检率和误报率的界限在高达86%的运行中保持有效。
tldr: 提出VLA-Tug，一种基于VLA骨干网络潜在层的轻量级校准探测器，可在极小推理开销下实现早期失败检测，并对漏检率和误报率提供有效界限。
en_tdlr: VLA-Tug, a lightweight calibrated probe over the latent layers of VLA backbones, enables early failure detection with bounded missed-detection and false-alarm rates at minimal inference overhead.
